description: Run a full reconnaissance sweep of a domain or URL and return a correlated report: web-security grade (via Astur), email-authentication posture (SPF/DMARC), nameservers, MX, registrar, subdomains from Certificate Transparency logs, the resolved IP's exposure (Shodan InternetDB) and reputation (GreyNoise), an overall roll-up grade, and prioritised highlights. Pass depth="deep" to also run the heavier OSINT (more calls, slower): RPKI route-origin validity, where to report a security issue (security.txt + the network's abuse mailbox), a dangling-CNAME subdomain-takeover scan, the resolved IP's folded reputation verdict (Spamhaus/FireHOL blocklists, GreyNoise, Feodo C2, Tor, DShield), the transport-security grade (certificate, revocation, HSTS preload) and the exposed CVEs ranked by KEV+EPSS — which can only WORSEN the overall grade (a malicious IP forces F; a D/F TLS posture or a known-exploited CVE floors it), never lift the web grade. An IP address is accepted too: the domain-level parts (email posture, nameservers, CT subdomains, takeover scan) are then skipped, email is null, RDAP describes the address's network, and the overall grade is the web grade alone ("N/A" when the address serves no web). Deep runs are bounded at about 45 s; a part that didn't finish is listed in `incomplete`. Use this for broad 'investigate X' requests; use the granular tools (scan_site, spf_check, …) for specific questions.

depth.description: Depth: "standard" (default) for the quick correlation, or "deep" to add RPKI, disclosure contacts, subdomain takeover, IP reputation verdict, TLS posture and CVE ranking.

target.description: Domain, URL or IP address to investigate, e.g. example.com, https://example.com or 192.0.2.1

name: investigate
